title: Measurement of mitochondrial respiration in adherent cells by Seahorse XF96 Cell Mito Stress Test
markdown:
## Protocol: Seahorse extracellular flux mitochondrial stress test in adherent mammalian cells

### Overview

This protocol outlines the Seahorse extracellular flux mitochondrial stress test for adherent mammalian cells (specifically HK-2 cells). The procedure spans four days, beginning with cell plating and transfection, followed by seeding into microplates and cartridge hydration. On the day of the assay, reagents are prepared, cells are equilibrated in non-CO2 conditions, and the assay is executed using the XF96 Analyzer. Post-assay data is exported via Wave software.

### Materials/Reagents

XF base medium, 100 mM pyruvate solution, 200 mM glutamine solution, D-glucose, 1 M NaOH, Oligomycin, FCCP, Rotenone/antimycin A, Seahorse XF Calibrant, DMEM medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, penicillin and streptomycin, SQSTM1/p62 overexpression plasmid, pcDNA3.1 (+) control plasmid.

### Equipment

Water bath, 0.22 μm filter, XF96 Cell Culture Microplate, hydrated sensory cartridge, Seahorse XFe96 Analyzer, computer running Wave software, USB drive, microscope, sterile 6-well plates, tissue culture hood, non-CO2 37°C incubator.

### Safety & Sterility

Maintain sterile conditions during cell handling and plating. Use antibiotics-free medium for initial plating to ensure optimal confluency at transfection. Ensure background wells do not contain cells. Verify cell health and confluence under a microscope before starting the assay.

## Reagent Preparation

### Day of the assay: day 4

1. Turn on the water bath and warm it to 37°C. Add 1 mL of 100 mM pyruvate solution, 1 mL of 200 mM glutamine solution, and 0.1 g of D-glucose to 98 mL of XF base medium. Filter the assay medium through a 0.22 μm filter. Warm the filtered assay medium to 37°C and adjust the pH to 7.4 using 1 M NaOH. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: Prepare the assay medium immediately before use and keep it at 37°C until application. Do not prepare excess medium; 100 mL is sufficient for one XF96 Cell Culture Microplate. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S02 -->
2. Suspend compounds in assay medium according to Table 1. Dilute stock solutions of Oligomycin, FCCP, and Rotenone/antimycin A according to Table 2. Load 20 μL of 2 μM oligomycin into port A, 22 μL of 1 μM FCCP into port B, and 25 μL of 0.5 μM Rotenone/antimycin A into port C of the hydrated sensory cartridge. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S03 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: Compounds must be prepared and loaded into the cartridge ports 20 minutes prior to the start of the assay. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S04 -->

## Assay Execution

### Day of the assay: day 4

1. Retrieve the XF96 Cell Culture Microplate from the cell incubator. Remove the cell growth medium, leaving 20 μL remaining, and replace it with 180 μL of assay medium. Repeat this replacement process three times. For the final replacement, aspirate 180 μL of assay medium and add 160 μL of fresh assay medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S01 -->
2. To de-gas the plate, incubate the XF96 Cell Culture Microplate in a 37°C incubator without CO2 for 1 hour. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S02 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Note: Cells must be incubated in a 37°C incubator without CO2 for 1 hour to de-gas prior to placing the XF96 Cell Culture Microplate on the analyzer tray. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S03 -->
3. Select 'XF Cell Mito Stress Test' from the Templates window. In the Plate map page, click 'add group' and select the corresponding wells to edit group information. In the Protocol page, set the parameters as follows: baseline phase with 3 cycles; inject port A (oligomycin) for 3 cycles; inject port B (FCCP) for 3 cycles; inject port C (Rotenone/antimycin A) for 3 cycles. Each cycle consists of mix for 3 min, wait for 0 min, and measure for 3 min (see Figure 5). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S04 -->
4. On the Run Assay page, select 'Start Run' and choose a directory to save the assay result file. The tray will auto-eject to place the sensory cartridge onto it, and the instrument will initiate calibration of the sensory cartridge. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S05 -->
5. Once calibration is complete, click 'open the tray', remove the utility plate, and place the XF96 Cell Culture Microplate onto the tray in the correct orientation as labeled on the corner (lower-left corner of the tray). Then, load the tray into the instrument. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S06 -->
> **Operational constraint:** CRITICAL: Before starting the assay, verify that compounds are correctly loaded in the injection ports. View cells under a microscope to confirm cell health, seeding confluence, and ensure that background wells are devoid of cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S07 -->

### 1 h 24 min

> **Operational constraint:** Note: The default XF Cell Mito Stress Test protocol does not require modification. The total duration for OCR measurements is 1 hour and 24 minutes. If readings are excessively slow, cell viability may be reduced, which will negatively affect results. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T1-S01 -->

### Post-assay

1. Upon completion of the run, remove the cell plate and the sensory cartridges. Insert a USB drive and export the results. The Wave software automatically generates and analyzes results, allowing data export as an Excel or Prism file. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T2-S01 -->
2. **Note:** Desirable range of starting OCR should be between 20 and 160 pmol/O _2 /min. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T2-S02 -->

## Cell Culture and Transfection

### Day 1: Plate cells

1. Day 1: Plate 5 × 10^4 HK-2 cells in a sterile 6-well plate containing 2 mL of growth medium (DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum) without antibiotics. This ensures cells reach approximately 60%-80% confluency at the time of transfection. [1] <!-- protocol-step:S26 -->

### Day 2: Transfect cells

#### Transfection of HK-2 cells: day 1 and day 2

1. Cells seeded in a sterile 6-well plate are transfected with SQSTM1/p62 overexpression plasmid and its control plasmid pcDNA3.1 (+). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T1-S01 -->

## Cell Seeding and Cartridge Hydration

### Seeding cells and hydrating sensory cartridge: day 3

1. Harvest and plate 6 × 10^3 HK-2 cells in 100 μL of growth medium (DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% penicillin/streptomycin) per well (Figure 2A). Leave four background temperature correction wells (A1, A12, H1, and H12) (Figure 3) blanked with 100 μL of growth medium only. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S01 -->
2. Allow the microplate to rest at 20°C-25°C in the tissue culture hood for 1 hour. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S02 -->
3. Incubate the cells for 12-18 hours in a standard cell culture incubator. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S03 -->
4. Separate the utility plate and sensory cartridge. Place the sensory cartridge upside down on the bench next to the utility plate (Figure 4). Fill each well of the utility plate with 200 μL Seahorse XF Calibrant. Gently lower the sensory cartridge back onto the utility plate, ensuring no air bubbles are created. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S04 -->
5. Incubate the assembled sensory cartridge in a humidified, non-CO2, 37°C incubator for 12-18 hours. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S05 -->
6. Power on the Seahorse XFe96 Analyzer, the non-CO2 37°C incubator, and the computer. Open the Wave software (Figure 1) and click 'Heater on'. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S06 -->
